question: How many repetitions of the ten-syllabled Ketu mantra are prescribed?
premises: The Ketu mantra consists of ten syllables.
This mantra is to be chanted.
The prescribed number of repetitions is twelve ayutas.
inference: The ten-syllabled Ketu mantra must be chanted one hundred twenty thousand times.
plain_english: This ten-syllabled Ketu mantra is to be chanted one hundred twenty thousand times.
